decisive_items: abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula, with increased intercapillary spacing and small areas of hypofluorescence nasal to the fovea
response.rationale: Sickle cell disease with characteristic sunburst lesions and a sickle-related macular capillary pattern with ischemic whitening and middle retinal layer OCT changes strongly supports sickle cell retinopathy/macular infarction. Absent cherry-red spot and normal vascular filling argue against CRAO; no diabetes or metabolic history argues against diabetic retinopathy.

rejected.why: Ischemic macular whitening can be seen, but no cherry-red spot and normal cilioretinal, arteriolar, and venous filling contradict central retinal artery occlusion.
No history or evidence of diabetes is provided, and the abnormal capillary findings are better explained by the patient's sickle cell disease.
